name: Ramp
description: Ramp lets agents work with spend data such as transactions, cards, and bills as the signed-in user, within that user's permissions. At sign-in the user chooses full or read-only access.

prompts.text: Which of my card transactions this month are missing receipts?
Summarize company card spend by department for last quarter.
Which bills are due in the next two weeks?

apps.name: Ramp
apps.description: Transactions, cards, and bills, over Ramp's MCP server with browser sign-in.
